calls.statement:
-- Average stock value at cost for Paint & Decorating category during FY2026/27 P03 (weeks 9-13)
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-06-29' AS start_date, DATE '2026-08-02' AS end_date
),
weekly_totals AS (
    -- Sum closing value across all stores and products within each week
    SELECT fs.week_ending_date,
           SUM(fs.closing_value) AS weekly_chain_value
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
      AND s.store_id < 900
      AND p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
)
-- Average across weeks
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weekly_chain_value), 2) AS avg_chain_stock_value_eur
FROM weekly_totals;

calls.statement:
-- Average closing stock value at cost for Paint & Decorating category for the whole chain
-- during FY2026/27 P03 (fiscal weeks 9-13, period 3 this year)
WITH params AS (
    -- FY2026/27 P03: weeks 9-13, dates 2026-06-29 to 2026-08-02
    SELECT DATE '2026-06-29' AS period_start_date, DATE '2026-08-02' AS period_end_date
),
weekly_chain_totals AS (
    -- Step 1: Sum closing value across all stores and products within each week
    SELECT fs.week_ending_date,
           SUM(fs.closing_value) AS weekly_total_value
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN params.period_start_date AND params.period_end_date
      AND s.store_id < 900  -- Physical stores only
      AND p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'  -- Exclude test articles
    GROUP BY fs.week_ending_date
)
-- Step 2: Average the weekly totals (do not sum across weeks)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weekly_total_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_eur
FROM weekly_chain_totals;
